title: Venezuelan Corn Fritters (Vegan)
description: Crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, these corn fritters are a delicious vegan twist on a traditional Venezuelan dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine corn, tagine, yeasty, and zesty.
Add vegan egg replacement and mix until a dough forms.
Add flour and mix until a thick batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Optional: Garnish with herbs and a sprinkle of salt.
